values.note: 2026 and 2027 Peak Season: $36/night for a standard electric site; the three double sites (16 people) are $72. Senior/Access pass half price.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232742/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-06 to 2026-10-31 and 2027-03-05 to 2027-10-30: 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' 36, the 48-person-unit variant 72) + campsite catalog (3 sites 'Max Num of People' 16), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232742 (58 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, all bookable: Electricity Hookup 30 x53, 50 x4, 15 x1; Water Hookup Y on all 58) + facility description ('58 sites with electric and water hookups'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Catalog Max Vehicle Length 30-75 ft (every site 30 ft or more, so a 23-ft rig fits all 58); 50 back-in, 8 pull-through. Up to four vehicles per site, boat and utility trailers included.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232742 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + facility notice ('four (4) vehicle per campsite limit ... This includes cars, trucks, campers, RVs, boat trailers, and utility trailers'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232742 (amenities 'Dump Station', 'Flush Toilets', 'Laundry Facilities', 'Showers'; description 'a dump station, laundry facilities and hot showers'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Read from the recreation.gov calendar: the 2026 season sold nights through Oct 30 (no November dates), and 2027 nights open from Friday March 5 (no February dates). The 2026 rate season began March 6, so the opening date moves a day or two year to year.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/232742/month (Oct 2026 last night Oct 30; Nov 2026 and Feb 2027 empty; Mar 2027 sites Available from 2027-03-05) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-03-06 to 2026-10-31), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Every site is reservable on recreation.gov. Weekend stays 2 nights, holiday weekends 3; 14 nights in any rolling 30. Check-in after 4 pm, check-out 3 pm. Gates locked 10 pm-7 am. Card payment only. A reservation more than a day late is cancelled as a no-show.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232742 (rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices on check-in/out, gates, card-only payment and no-shows) + campsite catalog (all 58 reservable), read 2026-10-29

note: USACE Mobile District, West Point Lake (western shore, near LaGrange). Paved roads, gravel pads; gates locked overnight. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov (facility, rates, per-site catalog, calendar): 58 bookable electric/water sites, $36 (2026 and 2027; double sites $72), 50A max, showers/flush toilets/laundry/dump. Added sites max 75 ft and pull-throughs, season Mar 5 - Oct 31 from the calendar, weekend 2 / holiday 3 / 14-night rules. Note cleaned (the '~35 ft pads' and 'Mar-Nov' season were wrong). No sewer attribute in the catalog (left unset).
